entries.title: CHILD OF NIGHT
entries.author: John French
entries.currentBlurb: A Knight-Errant confronts darkness born from the Heresy.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Malcador's agents face the corruption spreading through the Imperium.

entries.title: WOLF HUNT
entries.author: Graham McNeill
entries.currentBlurb: Space Wolves hunt a dangerous quarry through the void.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The VI Legion pursues their prey across the stars.

entries.title: THE WATCHER
entries.author: CZ Dunn
entries.currentBlurb: The mysterious Watchers in the Dark observe the Heresy unfold.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Ancient guardians witness the galaxy's civil war.

entries.title: GREY ANGEL
entries.author: John French
entries.currentBlurb: Garviel Loken operates as a Knight-Errant, hunting traitors in the shadows.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The former Luna Wolf serves Malcador in secret operations.

entries.title: LUNA MENDAX
entries.author: Graham McNeill
entries.currentBlurb: Deception and lies spread across Luna during the Heresy.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Terra's moon becomes a battleground of secrets and treachery.

entries.title: THE PURGE
entries.author: Anthony Reynolds
entries.currentBlurb: The Death Guard's corruption accelerates as they embrace Nurgle's gifts.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XIV Legion's transformation into plague-bearers continues.

entries.title: GHOSTS SPEAK NOT
entries.author: James Swallow
entries.currentBlurb: Garro encounters the silent dead during his missions for Malcador.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Knight-Errant faces ghosts of the past and future.

entries.title: ARMY OF ONE
entries.author: Rob Sanders
entries.currentBlurb: A lone operative undertakes an impossible mission for Malcador.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: One warrior against overwhelming odds in the Emperor's name.

entries.title: DISTANT ECHOES OF OLD NIGHT
entries.author: Rob Sanders
entries.currentBlurb: Ancient horrors from humanity's past resurface during the Heresy.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Old Night's terrors return to haunt the Imperium.

entries.title: LOST SONS
entries.author: James Swallow
entries.currentBlurb: Garro seeks lost loyalists from traitor Legions to join the Knights-Errant.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The search for loyal sons from fallen Legions continues.

entries.title: TEMPLAR
entries.author: John French
entries.currentBlurb: Sigismund, the Emperor's Champion, faces trials during the Heresy.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The greatest warrior of the Imperial Fists confronts his destiny.

entries.title: PATIENCE
entries.author: James Swallow
entries.currentBlurb: Garro learns patience is a virtue when hunting the Emperor's enemies.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: A Knight-Errant discovers that some prey requires patience to catch.

entries.title: THE SIGILLITE
entries.author: Chris Wraight
entries.currentBlurb: Malcador the Sigillite orchestrates his shadow war to save the Imperium. The Emperor's right hand works tirelessly to prepare for what must come.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Malcador conducts covert operations to preserve the Emperor's vision.

entries.title: THE GATES OF TERRA
entries.author: Nick Kyme
entries.currentBlurb: Defenders prepare Terra's gates for the coming siege.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Throneworld fortifies itself against inevitable attack.
